title: VerificationEvidence
description: A single piece of evidence from the VERIFY step. Each evidence item represents the result of one rule evaluation against the resource properties or schema.

source.description: The verification source that produced this evidence. 'grip.schema' for Tier 0 schema validation, 'grip.guard/registry' for Tier 1 provider rule registry, 'grip.guard' for Tier 1 local rules, 'grip.security' for Tier 2 heuristic fallback.

ruleId.description: Identifier of the rule that was evaluated. For schema validation (Tier 0): SCHEMA_UNKNOWN_PROPERTY, SCHEMA_READ_ONLY_PROPERTY, SCHEMA_REQUIRED_PROPERTY, or SCHEMA_TYPE_MISMATCH. For policy rules (Tier 1): the rule name from the corpus. For heuristic (Tier 2): a custom identifier.

ruleDescription.description: Human-readable description of the rule or the violation it detected.

propertyPath.description: The resource property path that was evaluated. Uses JSON pointer format (e.g., /properties/BucketName).

actualValue.description: The current value of the evaluated property. Set to 'NOT SET' when the property is absent. For schema validation, this is the proposed value that failed validation.

expected.description: The expected constraint or remediation action. For schema violations, includes fuzzy-match suggestions when applicable.
examples: Remove or rename this property. Did you mean: LoggingConfiguration?
Remove this property — it is set automatically by the provider.
Set BlockPublicAcls to true in PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.

corroborated.description: Whether this evidence represents a confirmed violation. true = the rule identified a non-compliant property value (VIOLATED). false = the rule passed (VERIFIED).

severity.description: Severity level of the finding. Schema violations: HIGH for unknown/read-only, MEDIUM for required/type-mismatch. INFORMATIONAL for rules that passed.

relatedRuleIds.description: Rule IDs that were deduplicated into this evidence item. Present when multiple rules flagged the same property path and were consolidated.
